title: Creamy Mushroom Rigatoni
description: Rigatoni tossed in a silky white-wine mushroom sauce with thyme and plenty of parmesan — proper comfort food.

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.note: finely grated, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Cook the rigatoni in well-salted boiling water until 1 minute shy of al dente; reserve 200 ml of the pasta water before draining.

Meanwhile, heat the oil and butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer and leave them alone for 3 minutes until deeply golden underneath, then toss and cook 2 minutes more.
Add the shallot, garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble down by half, scraping up the browned bits from the base of the pan.
Stir in the cream, bring to a gentle simmer, then add the parmesan and lemon juice and season.
Toss the drained pasta through the sauce with a splash of the reserved pasta water, loosening until glossy.
Serve immediately in warm bowls with extra parmesan and a crack of black pepper.

notesMarkdown:
## Golden mushrooms

The single biggest flavour move is **browning the mushrooms properly** — they should
look deeply coloured, not pale and steamed. Do it in batches if your pan is small.

## Lighter version

Swap half the double cream for chicken-style stock and finish with a spoon of
*crème fraîche* instead. The sauce stays silky but sits lighter.

## Freezing

The mushroom sauce freezes for up to 3 months. Reheat gently and toss with freshly
cooked pasta — freeze the pasta separately or not at all.
